description: Inner-benchmark tasks consumed by the PromptPotter connector's extract_experiment hook. Each task is one inner-cycle invocation; the outer L1's score for a candidate is composited (per campaign.json::scoring) over the three proxy metrics produced per task: first_round_delta, after_N_rounds_delta, rounds_to_N. Inner benchmark = justlogic depth-6/7 (~0.44 origin, clear headroom; gsm8k retired — its origin aces target). Target 0.60 (not 0.80) so rounds_to_N varies rather than saturating at the unreached sentinel — the paper ceiling on this stratum is ~0.81.
